notes.title: 2017.2.26 Update Info
notes.content:
We are thrilled to present you the English Voiceover with Stefanie Joosten doing the ICEY part. This is updated together with French localization and the support of all ratios of the screens. It is a completely FREE update.   

In this new version:
- English voiceover is added
- French localization is available now
- Supporting all ratios of the screens

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26877391/be77e81e298c26aa87f972d358604607209e612a.jpg[/img]

P.S.: Special Thanks to Fabien Dapremont for voluntarily localizing ICEY into French.  (♥◠‿◠)ﾉ   

Please contact ICEY@fantablade.com for any issue.

notes.title: 2016.12.5 Update Info
notes.content:
[h1]To the testers of[b] I™[/b] system experiment,[/h1]
 
In order to responed recent test feedbacks:
[list]
[*]Using controller feels not good enough,such as lack of vibration feedback.
[*]In battle,some performance of ICEY is quite extraordinary.
[*]ICEY`s voice.
[/list]
In response to these feedbacks we make an update for [b]I™[/b] system.
 
In new version
[list]
[*]Added vibartion feedback for some control commands.
[*]In response to some controversial performance,we optimized and improved some  rules in battle.
[*]ICEY`s dash ability is limited.Now based on the difficulty you choosed,energy bar of dashing will recovery differently.
[*]Using dash to avoid enemy`s attack is more difficult than before.
[*]ICEY`s voice code is updated,now she will speak by a brand new voice.
[/list]
 
If you have any questions with this game,please send an e-mail to  ICEY@fantablade.com to contacat us.
